title: Diamond SMP
description: Partial-Anarchy Community Economy SMP - Java/Bedrock, Voice Chat, 60k World, Actively Developed
body:
A brutal, player-driven survival world where nothing is safe and everything has value.

This is true anarchy survival mixed with a deep economy, long-term progression, and a massive world built for players who want freedom, risk, and reward.

Build. Raid. Trade. Betray. Rise to the top — or lose everything trying.

- Java/Bedrock/Console/Mobile!
- 60k Map Size - endless space to explore, build, and conquer
- No unfair advantages – no cheats, no exploits, just raw gameplay
- Shard currency – earn, trade, and spend on powerful rewards
- Shard Crates – Diamond -> Emerald -> Ancient -> Amethyst -> Ruby
- Auction House
- Leaderboards
- Spawners/Custom Equipment (Ancient Tools)
- Voice Chat
- Bounties
- Duels
- Monthly competitions!
